about: Centers that exist but are not listed on chabad.org. precision: 'exact' = real location, 'area' = rough spot in the right neighbourhood, 'city' = city centre (address unknown). note is shown on the dot's card. url, site, siteHe: the center's own page elsewhere (a center not on chabad.org), linked on its card as "Open on <site>" / "לדף ב<siteHe>". center-type: {name} as chabad.org's types (Mikveh, Jewish Community Center…), shown on the card. fixes: corrections to chabad.org's own listings, by center id (city, lat, lon; or personnel where chabad.org lists no one — a fix without lat keeps the listing's approx flag, and one that only moves a listing to the right town says approx: true). hyd: shluchim murdered al kiddush Hashem, by center id: each person is marked passed away with HY"D / הי״ד instead of obm / ע״ה (added to the center's people if chabad.org doesn't list them), and shown at the top of the center's card with memorial / memorialHe. review (not shown): why a center is flagged for the owner's review — a possible "mushroom", a network outside the country's official Chabad, or a shliach that couldn't be confirmed; the owner decides whether it stays.
